points: Read the mission before starting. Learn the controls, Run, Step and Oracle hints.
A new wallet starts with 20 coins. Each hint costs 6 coins; first clears award the configured rewards once.
Stage 2 is guided interface practice; the main flowchart lesson is Week 2.
lesson.title: Orientation

controls: Drag flowchart symbols onto numbered positions and follow the arrows. Check chart executes every case. Arrow keys and Enter also place selected blocks.
objective: Read a rectangle's width and height. Calculate its area and display the result. Problem values 10, 5; test inputs [{'width': 10, 'height': 5}, {'width': 5, 'height': 6}, {'width': 0, 'height': 7}, {'width': 5, 'height': 8}, {'width': 10, 'height': 9}, {'width': 15, 'height': 10}, {'width': 10, 'height': 10}, {'width': 10, 'height': 5}].
